company: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
about: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited is a retail jewellery company engaged in the marketing and sale of gold, diamond, and cubic zirconia jewellery. The company operates five retail showrooms across Mumbai and Ahmedabad under the company-owned company-operated (COCO) model. Its portfolio includes over 19,442 SKUs across 11 distinct collections certified under BIS Hallmarking standards.

objects.purpose: Funding inventory costs for 1 new showroom in Maharashtra and expansion in Gujarat
Repayment and/or prepayment, in full or part, of certain borrowings

promoters.background: Promoter Ramchand Murlidhar Raimalani has over 25 years of experience in the gems and jewellery industry, initially managing the business as a proprietorship from 1999 before consolidating into the company.

concentration.note: Significant geographic concentration in Gujarat, where two Ahmedabad showrooms accounted for 67.97% (₹366.16 crore) of total revenue in Fiscal 2026.

strengths: Multi-collection jewellery portfolio covering 11 collections across gold, diamond, and cubic zirconia to serve diverse customer price points.
Strong targeted omnichannel marketing and promoter-led social media presence across digital platforms and physical exhibitions.
Founder-led management supported by over 25 years of jewellery industry experience under promoter Ramchand Raimalani.
Strict commitment to product authenticity with mandatory BIS hallmarking for gold and IGI/GIA certifications for diamonds.
Robust revenue growth from ₹217.32 crore in FY24 to ₹538.74 crore in FY26 at a CAGR of 57.45%.

risks.title: Geographic concentration in Gujarat
risks.detail: Ahmedabad showrooms contributed 67.97% (₹366.16 crore) of FY26 revenue and 77.17% of FY25 revenue, making performance vulnerable to regional disruptions.

risks.title: Historical negative operating cash flows
risks.detail: The company incurred negative cash flows from operating activities in FY24, FY25, and FY26 due to heavy working capital and inventory investments.

risks.title: Complete dependence on physical showroom retail
risks.detail: 100% of sales are finalized at physical showrooms, making business operations susceptible to local footfall declines, economic disruptions, or lease terminations.

risks.title: Reliance on non-exclusive third-party manufacturers
risks.detail: The company relies entirely on third-party manufacturers and karigars who do not work exclusively, exposing it to potential supply interruptions and quality risks.

risks.title: Unappraised objects of the offer
risks.detail: Objects of the offer aggregating ₹182.84 crore for inventory and debt repayment are based on internal management estimates without bank appraisal.

risks.title: Raw material price volatility
risks.detail: Fluctuations in gold and diamond prices directly affect production costs, retail inventory values, and operational margins.

risks.title: Related party showroom leases
risks.detail: Showroom spaces have been leased from promoters Neelam Raimalani and Kush Raimalani, presenting potential conflicts of interest.

risks.title: Risk of theft, fraud, or inventory loss
risks.detail: Handling high-value precious stones and gold jewellery across retail stores creates continuous operational risks of theft, robbery, or employee negligence.

notes: Financial arrays reflect FY24, FY25, and FY26 audited restated figures; Q1FY27 stub period (revenue ₹101.44 cr, PAT ₹15.02 cr) ignored for financial arrays. Balance sheet details not provided in the excerpt.
